sample.note: This file was the maxresdefault image observed on the production home document. Bytes are Content download sizes for that one video, not a 30-sample field p75.

model: Displayed CSS width w needs about 2w source pixels. maxresdefault is 1280px wide, sddefault 640px, hqdefault 480px. A 400px detail starts at sddefault. A 112px card starts at hqdefault. Pixel counts are 1280*720=921600, 640*480=307200, 480*360=172800.

probe.model: maxresdefault still probes because YouTube can return a 120x90 placeholder. sddefault and hqdefault are real frames, so the extra Image() download is skipped. Saved bytes equal one full copy of the chosen file.

noise.rule: Single-object byte counts have no repeated-sample MAD. The ratios are exact for this video's files. Request count drops from 2 to 1 with no sample variance.
